name: s100-conventional-commit-allows-breaking-and-revert

tool_input.command: git commit -m "feat(api)!: remove the v1 routes"
git commit -m "revert: undo the search endpoint"

notes: Conventional Commits mark a breaking change with ! before the colon (with or without a scope) and have a revert type. The hook rejected all three (exit 2).
